verses: I also saw the soul of a woman who was suspended, by the breasts, to hell; and its noxious creatures (khrafstars) seized her whole body.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers such a punishment?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who, in the world, left her own husband, and gave herself to other men, and committed adultery.'
